answer: Because the vault deposit is held in the mirror escrow, the nadir audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases thus burns capital on every one it does not finish. Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 78 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. The deposit is 6 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
